name: nd-transfer-pricing
description: Use when a corporate group with North Dakota nexus needs the 2026 answer on North Dakota connected-party and unitary rules, namely worldwide combined reporting for a unitary business, the water's-edge election under N.D.C.C. 57-38.4-02 with its 3.5% additional tax and its foreign-dividend and 80/20 inclusion shares, the equally weighted three-factor formula with the single-sales-factor election under 57-38.1-09(4), and alternative apportionment under 57-38.1-18. Trigger on North Dakota combined return, ND unitary, water's edge surtax, 57-38.4-02, 57-38.1-18, ND intercompany, ND addback.
